title: Retail return window
text:
The retail return window is 30 days with a receipt. Returned items must be unused and include original packaging.

Return exceptions require supervisor review; a policy excerpt alone does not authorize a refund.

title: Retired return window receipt policy
text: The retail return window is 90 days with a receipt. This archived return policy is retained for audit and is not current.

title: Business return window
text: The business return window is 14 days with a receipt. Bulk orders require the account owner's review before any return.

title: Damaged items
text: Report damaged items within 7 days and attach photos. A damaged item may be reviewed even when packaging is opened.

title: Shipping delivery
text: Standard shipping delivery takes 5 business days. Expedited shipping delivery takes 2 business days; severe weather may delay either service.

title: Exchanges for unopened items
text: Exchanges for unopened items are allowed within 45 days. Exchanges do not extend the original refund return window.

title: Warranty for manufacturing defects
text: The warranty covers manufacturing defects for 12 months. Accidental damage is excluded from the warranty.

title: Supervisor escalation
text: Escalate policy exceptions to a supervisor before promising a refund. Record the order ID and missing evidence in the escalation ticket.

title: International customs fees
text: International customs fees are paid by the recipient. Support cannot estimate customs fees without destination and declared value.

title: Holiday return window
text: The holiday return window is 60 days with a receipt. This holiday exception only applies to purchases made in December.
